title: Jewelled Light Roasted Canadian Aubergine Gratin
description: A Mediterranean-inspired dish featuring roasted aubergine in a light, flavoursome Canadian claypot gratin.
instructions: Trim the ends of the aubergines and slice them into 1-inch thick rounds.
Layer the aubergine slices in a claypot, overlapping them slightly.
In a medium saucepan, melt the butter over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and cook, stirring occasionally, until fragrant, about 4 minutes.
Stir in the grated cheddar cheese until melted and smooth.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and stir in the crumbled feta cheese, chopped parsley, salt, pepper, red pepper flakes, and dried thyme.
Pour the milk into the saucepan and stir to combine.
Pour the milk mixture over the aubergine layers in the claypot.
Cover the claypot with a lid or foil and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the lid or foil and continue baking for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the aubergine is tender and the top is golden brown.
Let the gratin rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
